neighbours.label: ' two' in 'these two' (and the noun after it) picking out a pair, against the same sentence with a plain plural and no 'two'.
fire: The report compares these two groups of patients.
Of these two routes, the northern one is faster.
We spent these two weeks repairing the roof.
Neither of these two answers seems right to me.
With these two tools you can fix most leaks.
I have read both of these two books twice.
The mayor met these two reporters at city hall.
Between these two towns lies a wide river.
quiet: The report compares several groups of patients.
Of the routes, the northern one is faster.
We spent a few weeks repairing the roof.
Neither of the answers seems right to me.
With a few tools you can fix most leaks.
I have read all of those books twice.
The mayor met some reporters at city hall.
Between the towns lies a wide river.

notes: A flagged broad pole (4.5% of tokens reach 0.1 of max), so near misses read 0.1-0.2. A sub-trigger: commas after an age ('I was nine,') also reached 0.4 in probes and are not covered.
